description: This Java source file defines the SSLServerSocketFactory class which implements a custom SSL server socket factory for secure RMI communication. It handles SSL configuration, key store loading, and socket creation for SSL-enabled server sockets.

classes.name: SSLServerSocketFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates SSL server sockets for secure RMI communication, supporting configuration of keystore and client authentication.

methods.name: setNeedClientAuth
methods.description: Configures whether the server socket requires client authentication.

methods.name: setKeyStore
methods.description: Sets the keystore location, type, and password for SSL configuration.

methods.name: setKeyStoreAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias of the SSL certificate to be used.

methods.name: createServerSocket
methods.description: Creates and configures an SSL server socket on specified port using the provided keystore and SSL settings.
